source: Raw Blender armature audit; not a Unity Humanoid retarget result
method: Samples the imported FBX Action frame range and projects LeftFoot-RightFoot onto the current LeftUpperLeg-RightUpperLeg axis; knee separation uses LeftLeg-RightLeg on the same axis. Tolerance is 0.02 Blender units. Unity Avatar mapping and Humanoid retargeting can change these measurements; this report only filters raw FBX motion and cannot certify a Unity candidate.
